clue.text: Old drinking vessel ray found in tree

parts.note: a hollowed animal horn was an old drinking vessel
a beam is a ray of light

explanation.surface: A ray of light falls on an antique drinking horn in a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The hornbeam is a hardwood species found across Europe.

clue.text: One present at a particular hour on the river

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece on another sits after it

parts.note: at ten o'clock is at a particular hour
the Dee is a river in Britain

explanation.surface: Someone is present at a set time beside the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who attends an event is one who is there, present.

clue.text: Understanding where pub is to be built reportedly

indicators.note: says the phrase is heard, not read, giving the sound of the entry

parts.words: where pub is to be built
parts.note: an inn site is the plot where a pub will go

explanation.surface: Local people are told where a new pub will go up.
explanation.definitionFit: Insight is deep perception or comprehension of a matter.

clue.text: Tries to produce work for tutor?

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to produce work for their tutor.
explanation.definitionFit: Essays are attempts (verb, as in essays a task), and essays are pieces of written coursework a tutor sets.

clue.text: Information on girl in city

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
Eva is a girl's name

explanation.surface: News about a girl living in a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Geneva is a Swiss lakeside city, seat of many international bodies.

clue.text: It's fine, just for the moment

definitions.text: It's fine, just for the moment

parts.words: It's fine, just for the moment
parts.note: fine suggests pleasant and just for the moment suggests brief, the two halves of a phrase for a pleasingly concise thing

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs that something is acceptable for now.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes something brief and pleasant, fine but over quickly.

clue.text: He folds a thing suspiciously — showing this?

definitions.text: He folds a thing suspiciously — showing this?

indicators.note: acting suspiciously suggests trickery, so these letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: A magician folds something in a way that looks dodgy, hinting at trickery.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: a conjuror folding something suspiciously is showing manual trickery.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight of hand is a conjuror's manual dexterity used to deceive.

clue.text: If out of sorts, eat no hot Delhi dish

indicators.note: being out of sorts means disordered, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Feeling unwell, you skip a spicy Delhi meal.
explanation.walkthrough: TOAD IN THE HOLE is a British dish of sausages baked in batter.
explanation.definitionFit: This British meal of sausages baked in batter is a traditional dish.

clue.text: Some of those ancestors to appear in this?

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A medium summons forebears to show themselves at a sitting.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirits of the dead are supposedly summoned to appear at such a gathering.

clue.text: Ray's idea can be worked out probably

indicators.note: letters that can be worked out are rearranged into a solution

explanation.surface: A man called Ray has a plan that can be figured out.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase expresses a likely supposition, much as one might say presumably.

clue.text: Refusal to have good drink

parts.note: no is a refusal

explanation.surface: Turning down a good drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Nog is a strong ale, also a name for eggnog.

clue.text: A desire that's excessive, you'd concur?

parts.note: greed is excessive desire

explanation.surface: Someone asks if you'd accept that wanting too much is wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Said as a reply, the word signals consent, which is what a person who concurs would say.

clue.text: Spanish characteristic contrasting with her calmness

parts.note: his is the male counterpart of her
read with 'contrasting with' as well: the opposite of calmness is panic

explanation.surface: A Spanish trait sets him apart from her serenity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contrasting with' does duty for both pieces: the opposite of 'her' and the opposite of 'calmness'.
explanation.definitionFit: Hispanic means relating to Spain or Spanish-speaking peoples.

clue.text: Organic fertiliser in short supply for vegetable

indicators.note: short means cut, so the final letter of the fertiliser word is lost

parts.note: peat is organic matter used on gardens

explanation.surface: Gardeners find organic fertiliser scarce for growing vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: The pea is a green legume eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: Crushed, like missive in box?

explanation.surface: A letter in the postbox gets squashed.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamped means trodden down or crushed, and a letter posted in a box would bear a postage stamp.

clue.text: The old man has the right standard

parts.note: pa, like the old man, is a familiar word for father
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Father is set to the proper level.
explanation.definitionFit: Par is the normal or expected level, as in up to par.

clue.text: What Newton understood with great seriousness

explanation.surface: Newton grasped something with great solemnity.
explanation.definitionFit: Newton described the force pulling bodies together, and the word also means solemnity of manner.

clue.text: Can't they keep quiet stealing cattle?

explanation.surface: Thieves taking livestock seem unable to stay silent.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that rustle make soft noises, and cattle thieves in the American West were also called this.

clue.text: I've no car for transporting girl

indicators.note: transporting means moving the letters around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone without a car cannot give a girl a lift.
explanation.definitionFit: Veronica is a girl's name.

clue.text: Make progress in a social event around 5

indicators.note: the event word is put around the numeral

parts.note: a dance is a social event
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Getting ahead at a social gathering of five.
explanation.definitionFit: To advance is to move forward or gain ground.

clue.text: Supported a female meeting company man

parts.note: a firm is a business company
Ed is a man's name

explanation.surface: A woman meets a businessman and is backed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Affirmed means upheld or confirmed, a sense close to backed.

clue.text: Dropping with the cold?

parts.note: suggests a drip from a sniffling nose but describes a frozen hanging drop

explanation.surface: Someone with a chill has a dripping nose.
explanation.definitionFit: This spike of ice forms from water dripping in freezing weather.

clue.text: Times to get insects — any number to be trapped

indicators.note: the number is caught inside the insect word

parts.note: moths are insects
N stands for any number in algebra

explanation.surface: Periods spent catching insects, with many trapped.
explanation.definitionFit: Months are units of time on the calendar.

clue.text: Look at us, very silly!

indicators.note: silly means foolish or muddled, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims at how foolish we all look.
explanation.definitionFit: To survey is to examine or view something comprehensively.

clue.text: Against having soldiers retreating in tank

parts.note: V, for versus, means against

indicators.note: retreating means going back, so the soldiers' letters run backwards

parts.note: the TA, the Territorial Army, are reserve soldiers

explanation.surface: Troops fall back against a tank.
explanation.definitionFit: A vat is a large container for liquids, a kind of storage vessel.

clue.text: Farm that's awfully nice kept by hard woman

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

indicators.note: the jumbled word is held inside the woman's name

parts.note: Ada is a woman's name

indicators.note: awfully suggests something badly done, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A ranch that is very pleasant is run by a tough woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A hacienda is a large estate or ranch in Spanish-speaking countries.

clue.text: Us novelist in English city

explanation.surface: An American novelist living in an English city.
explanation.definitionFit: Jack London wrote The Call of the Wild, and the capital of England bears the same name.

clue.text: My advice was often sought — I'd help out with boat

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: a coracle is a small round boat

explanation.surface: A voice offering help with a small boat says its counsel was much in demand.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek oracle at Delphi was consulted for prophecy and counsel.
